stories.headline: Felipe VI makes surprise Easter trip to Mallorca for family reunion and private lunch
stories.summary: King Felipe VI made an unannounced visit to Mallorca during Easter week, dining with friends including singer Jaime Anglada and reuniting with his mother Queen Sofía and sisters Elena and Cristina at Marivent Palace. The visit coincided with broader royal family Easter activities including attendance at religious processions.

stories.headline: Former King Juan Carlos I returns to Spain for Seville bullfight, receives warm public reception
stories.summary: Juan Carlos I traveled from Abu Dhabi to Seville to attend the Easter Sunday bullfight at La Maestranza, his first visit to Spain since November. He was accompanied by daughter Elena and grandchildren and received enthusiastic applause from the crowd. The visit coincided with the declassification of 23-F documents.

stories.headline: CNI dismisses employee of Moroccan origin over security concerns, court upholds decision

The National Court upheld the dismissal, citing the employee's uncertain loyalty to Spain and family factors that made him vulnerable to foreign intelligence capture.

stories.headline: Andalusian election campaign intensifies with PSOE seeking to challenge Moreno's PP dominance

The PSOE seeks to energize its base while the PP aims to consolidate its position. Vox appears to be gaining ground while the left remains fragmented.
